description: List the changes learned pricing recorded for your workspace, newest first: for each product (or all products), the elasticity before and after, an example price before and after, and its status. status pending lists what waits for your decision; pass its id to decide_learned_price_change. A signed webhook announces each one as it happens, with its id. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope.

limit.description: Most changes to return. Defaults to 50.

status.description: Only changes with this status, e.g. pending.

name: list_learned_price_changes
